bds.h: Trump administration moves to drop lawsuit challenging Alaska Senate election result
bds.lede: The Trump administration on Thursday moved to effectively drop its lawsuit that sought to block the certification of Democrat Mary Peltola's victory in Alaska's U.S. Senate race, ending a much-criticized gambit by the president to prevent one of his political rivals from taking office.
rows: The Trump administration is moving to effectively drop its legal challenge to Democrat Mary Peltola's win in Alaska's Senate race.
The Justice Department is giving up on its controversial lawsuit that sought to potentially block the certification of Alaska's U.S. Senate race.

The Trump administration on Thursday moved to effectively drop its lawsuit that sought to block the certification of Democrat Mary Peltola's victory in Alaska's U.S. Senate race, ending a much-criticized gambit by the president to prevent one of his political rivals from taking office.
The Trump administration had sought to block certification of the election results if Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan lost. Democrat Mary Peltola won the race.
JUNEAU, Alaska (AP) — The Trump administration on Thursday moved to effectively drop its lawsuit that sought to block the certification of Democrat Mary Peltola's victory in Alaska's U.S. Senate
